resources.string: Applies to phone playback. System and DAC volume are independent; cast volume belongs to the receiving device.
Shared volume and gain for all devices
Remember volume and gain per output
USB bit-perfect output bypasses these controls, including mute. Use the DAC’s hardware volume.
Caps the sum of volume, gain and ReplayGain.
At higher gain, use the limiter in Advanced options to reduce clipping.
Volume and gain follow the output device. Foreground volume keys use the fine adjustment step.

When device memory is enabled, each output saves its own volume and gain. Foreground volume keys follow the selected step; volume up also unmutes. Background and lock-screen keys control system volume. Devices without a unique ID share records by type and name; identical USB DAC models share a record.
Volume could not be saved. Adjust it again to retry.
